# My last question is which 10 states have the largest Black incarcerated populations, on average?

incarerated_pop['date'] = pd.to_datetime(incarerated_pop['date'])

most_recent_year = incarerated_pop[incarerated_pop['date'].dt.year == 2022]

largest_black_population_2022 = most_recent_year.groupby('state')['incarcerated_black'].mean().sort_values(ascending = False)
